name: MORPHE sample retrieval benchmark
description: Human-authored queries; relevance is defined by an evidence snippet that must appear in the labeled chunk. scripts/build_eval_labels.py resolves snippets to stable memory IDs and prints every chunk for manual inspection.

queries.query: How does Django decide which view handles a URL?

relevant.evidence: Django checks the patterns in order and stops at the first match

queries.query: What path converters can I use in a Django route?

relevant.evidence: supports converters such as int, str, slug, uuid and path

queries.query: How do I avoid hard coding URLs and namespace an app's routes?

relevant.evidence: reverse("blog:detail", args=[3])

queries.query: Which middleware is switched on by default in a new Django project?

relevant.evidence: SessionMiddleware, CsrfViewMiddleware and AuthenticationMiddleware

queries.query: How do I configure Django to use PostgreSQL?

relevant.evidence: For PostgreSQL use ENGINE django.db.backends.postgresql

queries.query: Why does my Django loop run one database query per row?

relevant.evidence: Without them a loop over related objects issues one extra query per row

queries.query: How do I make several Django writes succeed or fail together?

relevant.evidence: Wrap related writes in transaction.atomic()

queries.query: Are Django QuerySets evaluated immediately?

relevant.evidence: QuerySets are lazy

queries.query: How does FastAPI validate request bodies?

relevant.evidence: Request bodies are declared as Pydantic models

queries.query: How do I share a database session between FastAPI endpoints?

relevant.evidence: Depends() shares logic such as database sessions

queries.query: When should I use async def instead of def in a FastAPI endpoint?

relevant.evidence: Declare endpoints with async def to await non blocking I/O

queries.query: How do I open and close clients when a FastAPI app starts and stops?

relevant.evidence: The lifespan context manager opens long lived clients

queries.query: Which index type should I use for jsonb columns?

relevant.evidence: Use gin for jsonb and full text search
Choose gin for jsonb and full text search

queries.query: When does autovacuum start cleaning a table?

relevant.evidence: autovacuum runs it automatically once about 20 percent of a table changed
Autovacuum cleans them up automatically once roughly 20 percent of a table has changed

queries.query: How much memory should shared_buffers get?

relevant.evidence: Set shared_buffers to roughly 25 percent of system RAM
A reasonable starting value for shared_buffers is about 25 percent

queries.query: How can thousands of clients share a few PostgreSQL connections?

relevant.evidence: Put pgbouncer in front of the database in transaction pooling mode
Run pgbouncer in transaction pooling mode in front of PostgreSQL

queries.query: What happens when Redis reaches maxmemory?

relevant.evidence: When maxmemory is reached the eviction policy decides

queries.query: How much data can I lose with AOF appendfsync everysec?

relevant.evidence: loses at most about one second of data

queries.query: How do I stop all cache keys from expiring at the same moment?

relevant.evidence: add jitter to TTL values to avoid a stampede

queries.query: How do I build a leaderboard in Redis?

relevant.evidence: Sorted sets power leaderboards through ZADD and ZRANGE

queries.query: How do I keep preprocessing consistent between training and prediction?

relevant.evidence: A Pipeline chains preprocessing such as StandardScaler

queries.query: How do I choose the number of clusters for KMeans?

relevant.evidence: Choose the number of clusters with the elbow method or the silhouette score

queries.query: Which metrics should I use when classes are imbalanced?

relevant.evidence: Accuracy misleads on imbalanced data

queries.query: How do I split data into training and test sets reproducibly?

relevant.evidence: Hold out data with train_test_split

queries.query: Why copy dependency files before the source code in a Dockerfile?

relevant.evidence: copy dependency manifests before the source code to keep rebuilds fast

queries.query: How do I keep container data after the container is removed?

relevant.evidence: Named volumes created with docker volume create persist data

queries.query: How do containers find each other by name?

relevant.evidence: Containers on a user defined bridge network resolve each other by service name

queries.query: How do I run several containers together from one file?

relevant.evidence: A compose.yaml file describes multi container applications

queries.query: What manages rolling updates of pod replicas?

relevant.evidence: A Deployment manages a ReplicaSet

queries.query: How do I expose pods outside the cluster?

relevant.evidence: NodePort opens a port on every node, and LoadBalancer provisions a cloud load balancer

queries.query: What is the difference between liveness and readiness probes?

relevant.evidence: The liveness probe restarts a container that is stuck

queries.query: Are Kubernetes Secrets encrypted?

relevant.evidence: Secrets are only base64 encoded by default

queries.query: Should I merge or rebase my feature branch?

relevant.evidence: git rebase replays commits on top of another base for a linear history

queries.query: How can I recover a commit after a bad reset?

relevant.evidence: The reflog records where HEAD pointed

queries.query: How do I undo a commit on a shared branch safely?

relevant.evidence: git revert creates a new commit that undoes an earlier one

queries.query: How do I find which commit introduced a bug?

relevant.evidence: git bisect finds the commit that introduced a bug

queries.query: How do I forward requests to a backend application with NGINX?

relevant.evidence: proxy_pass forwards requests to an upstream application

queries.query: Which TLS versions should NGINX allow?

relevant.evidence: Allow only TLSv1.2 and TLSv1.3 in ssl_protocols

queries.query: How do I keep a client on the same backend server every time?

relevant.evidence: ip_hash keeps a client on the same server

queries.query: How do I validate an NGINX configuration before reloading?

relevant.evidence: Test changes with nginx -t before reloading

queries.query: How do I update React state based on the previous value?

relevant.evidence: use the functional form setCount(c => c + 1)

queries.query: How do I clean up a subscription in useEffect?

relevant.evidence: the returned cleanup function runs before the next effect and on unmount

queries.query: Why shouldn't I use the array index as a list key?

relevant.evidence: Using the array index as key breaks state when items are reordered

queries.query: When do useMemo and useCallback actually help?

relevant.evidence: They only help when the value is passed to a memoized child

queries.query: What is the difference between interface and type in TypeScript?

relevant.evidence: Interfaces can be extended and merged

queries.query: How do I make every property of a type optional?

relevant.evidence: Partial<T> makes every property optional

queries.query: How do I narrow a union type?

relevant.evidence: Narrow it with typeof, in checks or a discriminant property

queries.query: Which compiler option turns on strict null checks?

relevant.evidence: Set strict to true in tsconfig.json

run EXPLAIN ANALYZE to see whether the planner chooses an index scan
